whatChanged: NEW: CVR Energy agrees to buy Marathon Petroleum's St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries plus marketing platform for ~$4.2bn, nearly doubling its refining capacity (cvi-mpc-refineries-acquisition)
NEW: Nikkei reports Mitsui Chemicals plans to buy chip-materials maker JSR from Japan Investment Corp. for over ¥1.3tn (~$8.2bn) (4183-jsr-acquisition)

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsors, strategics and insiders keep taking listed businesses off public markets. Thrive Holdings agreed to buy ADT for $10 a share in cash, about $15.3bn including debt, with a go-shop to 28 November (adt-thrive-take-private). A Trian-led group, Wendy's largest shareholder, offered $7.35 a share to take the chain private (wen-trian-take-private). Bon Secours Mercy Health agreed to buy Surgery Partners at $23.50 a share (sgry-bon-secours-take-private). EQT signed a board-recommended €46.50-a-share cash offer for Qiagen (qgen-eqt-take-private), and EQT Infrastructure signed a A$3.095-a-share scheme for Cleanaway (cwy-eqt-infrastructure-take-private). Penske Corporation and Mitsui are buying out the Penske Automotive float (pag-penske-mitsui-take-private), a GTCR-led consortium with Elliott is buying CCC Intelligent Solutions (cccs-gtcr-elliott-take-private), and Thoma Bravo's Proofpoint is buying Varonis (vrns-proofpoint-acquisition). Affle agreed to buy Perion for $11.70 a share in cash and delist it (peri-affle-acquisition), and Cencora is buying out American Oncology Network (cor-aon-acquisition). Tata's Iveco offer has cleared its 80% threshold (ivg-tata-motors-takeover-offer). New approaches keep coming: LCI's board rejected Monomoy's $101-a-share cash proposal in favour of its signed Patrick merger (lcii-monomoy-takeover-proposal), AVID and Warburg Pincus are bidding for Ingenia (ina-avid-takeover-proposal), and Challenger rejected a A$11.80 bid from its largest shareholder, TAL Daiichi Life (cgf-tal-daiichi-takeover-proposal). EP Group's Fnac Darty tender closes on 9 November with EU clearance in hand (fnac-ep-group-takeover-bid).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Regulators, politicians and courts, not the parties, keep deciding deals. Kimberly-Clark closed its Kenvue purchase on 2 November, but only after paying for EU and Australian clearance with feminine-care divestments and sitting through China's in-depth SAMR review (kmb-kenvue-acquisition). AkzoNobel and Axalta have formally offered EU remedies, including selling AkzoNobel's European refinish business, with the Commission's provisional deadline on 6 November (akza-axalta-merger). The ECB has cleared UniCredit to control Commerzbank, but Berlin still opposes it and the EU antitrust deadline is 16 November (cbk-unicredit-takeover); the ECB has also authorised Intesa to control Monte dei Paschi, leaving Consob and Italy's antitrust authority as the remaining gatekeepers (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). DoorDash's $17bn Instacart deal is already drawing antitrust warnings, with closing not expected before late 2027 (cart-doordash-uber-acquisition), and Marvell's $115bn Lumentum deal is not expected to close until the first half of 2028 (mrvl-lumentum-acquisition). EP Group's Fnac Darty bid needed EU merger clearance (fnac-ep-group-takeover-bid).

themes.label: Large-caps scaling up buybacks on surplus cash
themes.note: Companies with surplus capital keep expanding buybacks, each tying the larger programme to a specific capital tailwind. GM authorized a new $20bn buyback with its Q3 results (gm-buyback-2026), and Simpson Manufacturing replaced a $200m authorization with $1.0bn (ssd-buyback-2026).

themes.label: European incumbents consolidating domestic rivals for scale
themes.note: Europe's large banks, industrials and grocers are buying rivals to reach the scale of US and Chinese peers, while controlling shareholders, governments and supervisors decide the outcomes. Evonik's board formally refused on 30 October to negotiate over BASF's €24-a-share approach, about €11.2bn, so RAG-Stiftung's ~43% stake is now the decisive lever (evk-basf-acquisition). The ECB has cleared UniCredit to go past 30% of Commerzbank despite Berlin's opposition (cbk-unicredit-takeover). Intesa Sanpaolo has ECB authorisation for its Delfin-backed offer for Monte dei Paschi, and MPS holders voted down the CEO's rival bids for Banco BPM and Banca Generali (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Ahold Delhaize is buying Tesco's Czech and Slovak arm to make its Albert chain Czechia's market leader (ad-tesco-cz-sk-acquisition).

themes.label: North American energy companies buying scale in core assets
themes.note: Oil, gas and refining companies are paying up to deepen positions in assets they already know. EQT agreed an all-stock deal for Range Resources to consolidate Appalachian gas (eqt-range-resources-acquisition), Ovintiv is buying Logan Energy to add Montney acreage (ovv-logan-energy-acquisition), and CVR Energy is buying Marathon Petroleum's two Upper Midwest refineries for ~$4.2bn, nearly doubling its capacity (cvi-mpc-refineries-acquisition).
